metadata.title: That 1 random kill where I didn’t even peek but Valorant said ‘Take it, champ’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I wasn’t even ready for this!
Enemy must’ve been on a coffee break.
Click if your kills come from pure chaos and zero skill.
Valorant logic, making fools look like legends again.

Tap if your kills feel like unwanted freebies!
